title: Inpatient Facility Day Use Entries on Referrals and Authorizations
content:
When a facility claim line billed under a Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization or an Inpatient Mental Health Authorization covered under TRICARE Select has posted, its use is entered against that authorization under **Referrals and Authorizations**: from the facility line most recently posted for it, keeping the line's claim number and line number, with the first day of the line that the posting counts as the use's service date.

## What the use entry records

- One use entry in the authorization's unit history, tied to the claim number and line number printed on the Explanation of Benefits and to a service date.
- The inpatient days the line uses against the authorization; the authorization's units remaining fall by the days posted.
- The authorization's status, validity span and servicing facility do not change.

## Invocation

The tool is `post_facility_day_use_bc338a65`. It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call adds exactly one use entry.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `referral_authorization_id` | the reference number of the facility authorization the days are posted to, as returned by the referral and authorization lookup for the patient | identifier, as returned |
| `claim_number` | the claim number of the facility claim line, exactly as it appears on the claim line returned by the claim-line lookup | copied character for character, no reformatting |
| `line_number` | the line number of that facility claim line within its claim, exactly as shown on the claim line | whole number, 0 or more (in practice 1 or more) |
| `service_date` | the service date recorded on the use entry: the first day of that facility line that the posting counts as used | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `units` | the number of inpatient days the line uses against the authorization, counted in the authorization's unit of inpatient days | whole number, 0 or more |

## Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with these fields: `use_entry_id` (the reference number of the new use entry), `referral_authorization_id` (the authorization posted to), `units_posted` (the inpatient days posted), `units_remaining` (the authorization's units remaining after the posting) and `status`, which reads "posted" when the use entry was recorded.

## Illustration (hypothetical receipt)

A call for a hypothetical facility line with claim number SC-7781 and line 2, service date 2026-03-03 and 7 units returns a receipt whose `units_posted` is 7, whose `units_remaining` is the units left before the call less 7, and whose `status` is "posted".
